name: jwx-signpair
instr:
**Settlement batches from our partner won't decrypt**

We swap encrypted settlement batches with a partner in both directions, as compact JWEs to each
other's EC keys. They're on go-jose, we're on jwx. Every batch they send us fails in
`jwe.Decrypt`:

```
jwe.Decrypt: failed to decrypt any of the recipients: tried 1 keys, but failed to match any of the keys with recipient: jwe.Decrypt: failed to decrypt payload: aead.Open failed: cipher: message authentication failed
```

One of their batches and the staging key it's encrypted to are in /workdir/evidence. It's the
right key, the kid in their header matches our staging config.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file in the package it exercises (say
./repro_test.go), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a real test failure,
not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added. It can read files from /workdir/evidence.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix it at the source rather than special-casing my input. The fix belongs in
the library itself, not in the tests. CI runs
